If I could change one thing about iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, I would disable the new downward swipe gesture to summon Siri AI. There were already plenty of ways to invoke Siri, and I have always been used to swiping down on the iPhone and iPad to open Notification Center, so this new action does not affect my habit either.

On the Mac side, macOS 27 Golden Gate is almost entirely good news. Even at the end of August, the new betas are still adding plenty of welcome changes. Still, before macOS 27 launches officially next month, there is one change I would still like to see.

macOS 27 Golden Gate makes it harder to check battery percentage on MacBook

macOS 27 Golden Gate has redesigned the battery control item in the menu bar. By default, it only shows the battery shape icon, without the percentage.

At first glance, there does not seem to be anything wrong with this state of affairs. I have even disabled the percentage display on my own iPhone, which uses a similar battery icon. However, I have always liked being able to see the percentage on the Mac.

If you turn on the 'Show Percentage' option in macOS 27 Golden Gate, the number is placed inside the battery icon. I suspect Apple is trying to keep the design consistent with the iPhone in iOS 27.

Placing the percentage inside the battery icon on the iPhone is a compromise Apple made to cope with the tight space to the right of the notch or Dynamic Island. But on the Mac, even in the menu bar, I have not run into any lack of screen space.

I have been using macOS 27 Golden Gate on a 15-inch MacBook Air since the very first developer beta. I have found that, because it is harder for my eyes to make out, I am checking the battery percentage less often overall.

I hope Apple will reconsider this point in future design decisions, especially if more users find it problematic. In the meantime, I have at least worked around the issue myself.

I used Codex to build a simple menu bar utility that clearly shows the battery status and percentage the way I want it. If you find it useful, you can download and install it for free here.
